name: devlog-jira
description: Sends a finished timesheet to Jira as worklogs, one per entry, on the issue set on the task (or a canvas above it). Sending again only creates, updates or deletes what changed.

canvasFields.label: Jira issue
canvasFields.description: Time on this canvas, and on canvases inside it that don't set their own, is logged on this issue.

settings.label: Jira address
settings.description: The address you open Jira at.

settings.label: Account email
settings.description: Jira Cloud: the email you sign in with. Jira Data Center: leave empty and use a personal access token below.

secrets.label: API token
secrets.description: Jira Cloud: create one at id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens. Data Center: a personal access token from your Jira profile.
